name: ant-id-training
description: Plateforme d'entraînement à l'identification des fourmis avec frontend React/Vite et backend Express/Prisma.

scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/backend && npm run test -w apps/frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w apps/backend && npm run test:coverage -w apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/backend && npm run lint -w apps/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.docker:up: docker compose build --no-cache frontend --no-cache backend && docker compose up -d --build

author: Anathos
